evidence.quote: if (existing.some((b) => b.isActive() && b.stay.overlaps(stay))) throw new Error(`Room ${roomId} is already booked`);

answer.rationale: The no-overlap rule across a room's active bookings must hold at every commit. No aggregate owns that set, since Booking is a single instance. The application service checks it under a lock and uses the domain helpers isActive and overlaps only to compute it. The rule names this case as a violation.
